name: Aggregate
note: Dash has no Grafana JSON; this is the portable dashboard definition. Contains no connection secrets.

panels.title: Hourly regional energy
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.2 / 7.3  Panel P1 (Aggregate): hourly regional energy, kWh.
-- Source: cagg_hour_region continuous aggregate (already CAT-hour x region).
-- No measurement query may touch energy_readings.
SELECT bucket,
       region,
       sum(sum_energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh
FROM cagg_hour_region
WHERE bucket >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND bucket <  %(end)s::timestamptz
GROUP BY bucket, region
ORDER BY bucket, region;

panels.title: Daily network energy
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.2 / 7.3  Panel P2 (Aggregate): daily network energy, kWh.
-- Source: cagg_15min_region re-bucketed to CAT days (origin 2026-09-01).
-- Sum stored energy sums; never average averages.
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', bucket,
                   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS bucket,
       sum(sum_energy_kwh)                               AS energy_kwh
FROM cagg_15min_region
WHERE bucket >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND bucket <  %(end)s::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Network energy in seven-day periods
panels.source: cagg_15min_region (re-bucketed to CAT days, mapped to periods)
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.2 / 7.3  Panel P3 (Aggregate): network energy in the four seven-day
-- periods, kWh. Source: cagg_15min_region re-bucketed to CAT days, mapped onto
-- the four Section 5.1 periods (bucket origin 2026-09-01 00:00+02).
WITH periods(period, p_start, p_end, ord) AS (
    VALUES
      ('1-7 Sep',   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-08 00:00:00+02', 1),
      ('8-14 Sep',  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-08 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-15 00:00:00+02', 2),
      ('15-21 Sep', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-15 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-22 00:00:00+02', 3),
      ('22-28 Sep', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-22 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-29 00:00:00+02', 4)
),
daily AS (
    SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', bucket,
                       TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS d,
           sum(sum_energy_kwh)                               AS energy_kwh
    FROM cagg_15min_region
    WHERE bucket >= %(start)s::timestamptz
      AND bucket <  %(end)s::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.period          AS period,
       sum(daily.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh
FROM periods p
JOIN daily
  ON daily.d >= GREATEST(p.p_start, %(start)s::timestamptz)
 AND daily.d <  LEAST(p.p_end,   %(end)s::timestamptz)
GROUP BY p.period, p.ord
ORDER BY p.ord;

panels.title: Daily energy of selected meter
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.2 / 7.3  Panel P4 (Aggregate): daily energy of the selected meter.
-- Source: cagg_day_meter continuous aggregate (CAT-day x meter_id).
SELECT bucket,
       sum_energy_kwh AS energy_kwh
FROM cagg_day_meter
WHERE meter_id = %(meter)s
  AND bucket >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND bucket <  %(end)s::timestamptz
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Completeness by region
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.2 / 7.3  Panel P5 (Aggregate): completeness by region, percent.
-- observed = SUM(reading_count) from cagg_15min_region (sum stored counts,
--            never average averages).
-- planned  = registered meters in the region x 96 readings/day x days in range,
--            computed from the meters table and the selected CAT-day period.
WITH reg AS (
    SELECT region, count(*) AS registered
    FROM meters
    GROUP BY region
),
obs AS (
    SELECT region, sum(reading_count) AS observed
    FROM cagg_15min_region
    WHERE bucket >= %(start)s::timestamptz
      AND bucket <  %(end)s::timestamptz
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT reg.region              AS region,
       reg.registered          AS registered,
       obs.observed            AS observed,
       reg.registered * 96
           * ((%(end)s::date - %(start)s::date))            AS planned,
       100.0 * obs.observed
           / (reg.registered * 96
              * ((%(end)s::date - %(start)s::date)))        AS completeness
FROM reg
JOIN obs USING (region)
ORDER BY split_part(reg.region, ' ', 2)::int;
